description: MUTATES one existing calendar event the authenticated user owns. Required: event_id (UUID). Optional patch (same fields as log_event): title, date / event_date, time / event_time, end_date, end_time, location, description, category, external_url, visibility, people / with / person_ids. Unknown or other-user event_id returns an error and does not create a row. For food-diary meals, prefer update_food (it syncs the mirrored event). Rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

category.description: e.g. funeral, family, work, travel. Stored as events.category and event_type.

date_precision.description: Soft date precision stored in metadata.

end_time.description: Optional end time (same formats as event_time).

event_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY. Alias: date.

event_id.description: UUID of a calendar event the authenticated user owns

event_time.description: Start time: 8pm, 20:00, or 20:00:00. Empty or null clears. Alias: time.

people.description: People names or person UUIDs to add (event_people role=with). Does not remove existing tags.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original successful result).

visibility.description: Updates both events.visibility and the enforced events.is_private flag.

name: update_event

changed.description: Changed fields with before and after values.

items.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

title: Update Event (calendar patch)
